title: Trade-In Agreements Shortfall Coverage Terms
content:
Where the payoff owed on a traded vehicle is more than its trade value, or a later chargeback leaves the trade equity below zero, the customer under **Trade-In Agreements** owes a shortfall. The funding desk terms below set, per condition grade, how and how fast a shortfall is covered.

| Term | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Customer-paid negative equity due within (calendar days after pickup) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Channels accepted for a customer-paid shortfall | ACH, wire, cashier's check | ACH, wire, cashier's check | ACH, wire, cashier's check | ACH, wire, cashier's check | ACH, wire, cashier's check | ACH, wire, cashier's check |
| Negative equity may be rolled into a Kestrel Auto Finance contract on the linked purchase | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Shortfall left by a title-delay chargeback paid within (calendar days after the chargeback) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Terms in brief

1. A customer-paid shortfall on negative equity is received within 5 calendar days after pickup, at every grade.
2. Only ACH, wire and cashier's check are listed as accepted channels for a customer-paid shortfall.
3. Roll-in of negative equity into Kestrel Auto Finance is available at every grade except the Inoperable Condition Offer.
4. A shortfall resulting from a title-delay chargeback is paid within 10 calendar days after the chargeback, at every grade.

## Points of reading

- **Can an Inoperable Condition Offer roll negative equity into financing?** No; at that grade the roll-in switch is off.
- **Is a debit or credit card among the listed channels?** No. The listed channels are ACH, wire and cashier's check.
